name: Bernard of Clairvaux
bio:
Burgundian monk who joined the new abbey of Cîteaux in 1113 and two years later founded Clairvaux, which he led until his death; through him the Cistercian order spread across Europe, and he preached the Second Crusade.

His eighty-six sermons on the Song of Songs, preached to his monks from 1135 to the end of his life, reach only the opening of the third chapter; they read the Song as the love of Christ and the Church and of the Word and the soul. He is honoured as a saint and Doctor of the Church, and Luther and Calvin quoted him with respect.
